title: ZoomGain: Mining Global-to-Zoom Perception Gaps for Fine-Grained Visual Supervision
abstract: arXiv:2611.14076v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fine-grained visual perception requires Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to locate and interpret subtle evidence within complex scenes. Constructing supervision for this ability is challenging: questions must have correct, unambiguous answers that depend on actual fine-grained visual details rather than coarse cues or language priors. Verifying these properties makes manual annotation labor-intensive and automatic generation difficult for models that themselves struggle with fine-grained perception. Yet the same models can often recognize such details once the region is zoomed in. We exploit this global-to-zoom perception gap and introduce ZoomGain, a data construction pipeline that constructs questions about the full image from visual information gained only by zooming in. It verifies each answer on the zoomed view with multiple models, ensures that each question remains unambiguous in the full image and cannot be answered from language

translated_title: ZoomGain：挖掘全局到缩放的感知差距以实现细粒度视觉监督
translated_abstract: 细粒度视觉感知要求视觉语言模型（VLM）能够定位并解读复杂场景中的细微证据。为这种能力构建监督数据十分具有挑战性：问题必须具有正确、无歧义的答案，且答案应依赖于真实的细粒度视觉细节，而非粗略线索或语言先验。验证这些特性使得人工标注非常费力，而对于自身就难以进行细粒度感知的模型来说，自动生成也同样困难。然而，同样的模型在区域被放大后往往能够识别这些细节。我们利用这种“全局到缩放”的感知差距，提出了ZoomGain——一个数据构建流水线，它仅通过放大获得的视觉信息来构建针对完整图像的问题。该流水线通过多个模型在缩放视图上验证每个答案，并确保每个问题在完整图像中保持无歧义、且无法仅凭语言先验回答。
tldr: ZoomGain利用视觉语言模型“放大后能识别细节、全局视角却难以感知”的差距，构建了一种仅依赖缩放所得视觉信息、并经多模型在缩放视图上验证的细粒度视觉监督数据自动生成流水线。
en_tdlr: ZoomGain exploits the global-to-zoom perception gap in VLMs to automatically construct unambiguous fine-grained visual supervision data, where questions about full images are derived solely from information gained by zooming in and verified by multiple models on the zoomed views.
